sealed-classes-concept-040.title: Restrict an inheritance hierarchy
sealed-classes-concept-040.short: Use sealed types to control permitted subtypes
sealed-classes-concept-040.summary: Sealed classes and interfaces declare which types may directly extend or implement them.
sealed-classes-concept-040.why: A closed hierarchy makes domain models and exhaustive reasoning easier while retaining inheritance.
sealed-classes-concept-040.tips: Use final, sealed, or non-sealed on permitted direct subclasses as required.

compact-number-format-concept-040.title: Format compact numbers
compact-number-format-concept-040.short: Render values such as 1K or 1M by locale
compact-number-format-concept-040.summary: CompactNumberFormat provides locale-aware compact representations for large numbers.
compact-number-format-concept-040.why: It avoids hand-written suffix rules and respects locale-specific formatting conventions.
compact-number-format-concept-040.tips: Choose SHORT or LONG style according to the available display space.

files-read-string-code-040.title: Read a text file into a String
files-read-string-code-040.short: Use Files.readString for small text files
files-read-string-code-040.summary: Files.readString reads an entire text file using a chosen character set.
files-read-string-code-040.why: It is concise when the whole file is intentionally loaded at once.
files-read-string-code-040.tips: For very large files, stream lines or use a reader instead of holding everything in memory.

completion-exception-040.title: Handle CompletionException
completion-exception-040.summary: CompletionException wraps failures observed through operations such as CompletableFuture.join.
completion-exception-040.why: Asynchronous work cannot throw its original checked exception directly at the later join point.
completion-exception-040.tips: Inspect getCause() and handle the underlying failure at an appropriate boundary.

no-such-file-exception-040.title: Handle a missing file
no-such-file-exception-040.summary: NoSuchFileException reports that a requested file or directory does not exist.
no-such-file-exception-040.why: File-system state can change between checks and operations, so missing paths remain a normal I/O failure case.
no-such-file-exception-040.tips: Catch it when absence is expected; otherwise let the surrounding I/O error handling report it.

sealed-permits-error-040.title: Implement a sealed type without permission
sealed-permits-error-040.summary: A class cannot directly implement or extend a sealed type unless the hierarchy permits it.
sealed-permits-error-040.why: The sealed declaration intentionally controls the set of direct subtypes.
sealed-permits-error-040.tips: Add the subtype to permits when appropriate or redesign the hierarchy.

switch-expression-no-result-error-040.title: Leave a switch-expression branch without a value
switch-expression-no-result-error-040.short: Every completing branch must produce a result
switch-expression-no-result-error-040.summary: A block arm of a switch expression must yield a value when it completes normally.
switch-expression-no-result-error-040.why: The entire switch expression needs a value compatible with its target type.
switch-expression-no-result-error-040.tips: Use yield inside block arms or an arrow expression for simple values.

rawtypes-warning-040.title: Use a raw generic type
rawtypes-warning-040.short: Keep generic type arguments instead of dropping them
rawtypes-warning-040.summary: The rawtypes lint warning identifies uses of generic classes or interfaces without type arguments.
rawtypes-warning-040.why: Raw types bypass part of Java's compile-time type checking and can move failures to runtime.
rawtypes-warning-040.tips: Specify the intended type argument and use the diamond operator when construction can infer it.

integer-overflow-trap-040.title: Overflow before assigning to long
integer-overflow-trap-040.summary: An expression using only int operands is evaluated as int even when its result is later assigned to long.
integer-overflow-trap-040.why: Overflow happens during the arithmetic operation, before the widened assignment can preserve the value.
integer-overflow-trap-040.tips: Make at least one operand long before multiplication when the int range may be exceeded.

completable-future-join-trap-040.title: Wait on futures one by one
completable-future-join-trap-040.short: Coordinate a group before consuming results
completable-future-join-trap-040.summary: Joining futures individually in a traversal can obscure group coordination and failure handling.
completable-future-join-trap-040.why: CompletableFuture.allOf expresses the synchronization point for a set of independent asynchronous tasks directly.
completable-future-join-trap-040.tips: Use allOf for coordination, then read individual results when their values are needed.
